items.body: @manninglucas can you please mark this ready to import?

Rebased onto current master (`a4d9fdee9`). The production changes and
regression tests are unchanged; the conflict resolution retains imports
required by newer sandbox tests.

@manninglucas, could you review the updated head, `728f546af`?

Assisted-by: Codex

> TestUIDMap in container_test appears to be failing.

Link?

> TestUIDMap in container_test appears to be failing.

Fixed in https://github.com/google/gvisor/pull/15920 and unrelated to this change, right? Can you please advance this one through the machine if you agree?

@EtiennePerot, I checked the failed import's complete diff against the
[public test log][1]. Both `TestUIDMap` failures occur in `New`, while boot
reads an [empty mount message from the gofer][2], before `Start`.

The test leaves `OOMScoreAdj` unset, and failed construction leaves
`c.Sandbox` nil, so cleanup also skips the OOM adjustment. The pidfd helper
extraction preserves the previous implementation. I found no changed
behavior on the failing startup path.

This is also different from #15920: the failed CI cases use a temporary
directory under `/home`, without that test's duplicate `/tmp` mount. The
underlying gofer failure remains unexplained because its log was not
uploaded; #15927 adds that capture.

Could you reconsider the changes-requested review on this PR?

[1]: https://buildkite.com/organizations/gvisor/pipelines/pipeline/builds/51218/jobs/01a148c3-2747-4186-b50d-f9bc3fc7c1fc/artifacts/01a148c6-edef-45cd-a2a8-d81e6d7208e4
[2]: https://buildkite.com/organizations/gvisor/pipelines/pipeline/builds/51218/jobs/01a148c3-2747-4186-b50d-f9bc3fc7c1fc/artifacts/01a148c6-f8d1-428b-a26c-a6d15bc0e964
